subject.title: fix(status): LINE /status intermittent no-response — fallback, timeout, and retry hardening

question: Should `/status` return fallback text after a fixed 10 seconds for every `buildStatusReply` caller, or should that timeout be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The loader retry hardening is a bounded bug fix, but the timeout is a user-visible delivery policy choice that can replace a slow successful status response with fallback text.

options.title: Accept 10s Fallback After Proof
options.body: Keep the 10s cutoff if maintainers want fast visible failure, but require redacted proof of the timeout or retry fallback path before merge.

options.title: Narrow Timeout Scope
options.body: Limit the timeout to a maintainer-approved LINE/status boundary if the global `buildStatusReply` behavior is too broad.

options.title: Remove Timeout For Now
options.body: Merge only the loader retry/static-import hardening and defer timeout policy to a separate review.

recommendation.title: Accept 10s Fallback After Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the 10s cutoff if maintainers want fast visible failure, but require redacted proof of the timeout or retry fallback path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are recorded as reviewer and co-author of the status runtime extraction that created the boundary this PR changes.
